runners.comment: 2-3 as juvenile; well beaten on handicap debut at Goodwood (7f) last May; has been gelded.
runners.name: Yankee Dude
runners.spotlight: Won twice as a juvenile, including when justifying favouritism in a Kempton novice (7f) in October 2024; has raced just once since, finishing well down the field on handicap debut at Goodwood (7f) nearly 11 months ago; 3lb lower, and now gelded; monitor only.

runners.comment: Narrowly edged out Sergeant Pep in 7f Class 4 at Lingfield (13-8 fav) latest; 2lb higher.
runners.name: One More
runners.spotlight: British form figures 2221321; returned from a slightly less productive stint in Dubai to narrowly edge out Sergeant Pep in a 7f Class 4 at Lingfield (13-8 favourite) ten days ago; with consistency being his forte, he should be one the premises once again from just 2lb higher.

runners.comment: Downed the odds-on favourite in style at Newcastle (7f, novice) recently; handicap debut.
runners.name: Recency Bias
runners.spotlight: Built on a promising start (here and Doncaster) when downing the odds-on favourite in style at Newcastle (7f, novice; 15-8) over a fortnight ago; switches to handicapping on this similar Tapeta surface from a workable opening mark of 83; a fascinating contender.

16:15.race_name: Free Race Replays On attheraces.com Handicap

runners.comment: Dictated steady pace when scoring at Lingfield (2m); still nicely weighted off 2lb higher.
runners.name: The Craftymaster
runners.owner: R Miles V Miles T Stamp & Partner
runners.spotlight: Back to winning ways lately, scoring at Chelmsford (1m6f; in blinkers) and Lingfield (2m; in cheekpieces), dictating a steady pace latterly; 2lb higher now but still nicely weighted on historic form so should give another positive showing.

runners.comment: C&D winner (18-1) in January; less effective the last twice; tongue-tie now added.
runners.name: V Power
runners.spotlight: Off the mark over C&D (18-1) in January under Zoe Lewis; disappointing at Newcastle (12.5f) next time and didn't see out his race back here (sixth) last week; tongue-tie now added.

runners.comment: 0-6 for J Macey; latest Newcastle third (1m2f) fine; easing mark helpful; stamina unknown
runners.name: Kameel
runners.spotlight: Dual Newcastle scorer (7f maiden/novice) for John Butler, the latest last February; 0-6 for this yard and although close up over 1m2f at Newcastle last month, his stamina is unknown for this far.

runners.comment: Knuckled down to score narrowly at Chelmsford (about 1m5f) recently; player off 2lb higher
runners.name: Kings Cruiser
runners.spotlight: Getting to grips with the task, knuckling down to score narrowly at Chelmsford (about 1m5f) 11 days ago; a subsequent 2lb rise is fair and he has experience of this track to draw upon; one to consider seriously.

runners.comment: 6-38; making stable debut when second-best to progressive rival at Southwell (1m6f) latest
runners.name: Rubellite
runners.spotlight: 6-38, the bulk of them for Stella Barclay; with Richard Fahey for some of 2025, winning over 1m4f here (3lb lower) last September; runner-up to progressive rival at Southwell (1m6f) latest on debut for this trainer; a possible.

runners.comment: Won a small-field contest at Yarmouth (11.5f) last August; stamina questionable
runners.name: Shabu Shabu
runners.owner: Middleham Park Racing Xxii & Da Bin Lo
runners.spotlight: Won a small-field contest at Yarmouth (11.5f) last August; run down late in added blinkers at Pontefract (1m2f) the following month; perfectly entitled to draw benefit from last week's comeback run at Southwell but stamina questionable.

runners.comment: Lingfield winner (11.5f, good) for James Owen last June; on 2nd trainer since
runners.name: Colinski
runners.spotlight: First-time cheekpieces fitted when making winning handicap debut at Lingfield (11.5f, good; for James Owen) last June; mixed form since, although he did finish runner-up at Bath (2m1f, soft) on sole start for Georgina Nicholls; better than position suggests (hampered) on Newcastle AW latest.

runners.comment: No AW win since Jan 2023 (Newcastle, 12.5f); more than enough to prove after layoff
runners.name: Crystal Guard
runners.spotlight: No AW win since January 2023 (Newcastle, 12.5f); managed to score at Musselburgh (12.5f, good) last July but fortunes dipped markedly towards the end of the turf season; more than enough to prove after layoff.

runners.comment: Modest third on handicap debut at Bath (1m6f; 50-1) last September; seasonal reappearance.
runners.name: Golden Samba
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced; hasn't shown a massive amount and was only a modest third on handicap debut at Bath (1m6f, soft; 50-1) last September; tough to know what to expect on AW return/seasonal reappearance.

runners.comment: Has beaten only a handful of rivals in last nine starts; stablemate of The Craftymaster.
runners.name: Alex The Great
runners.spotlight: Won from 14lb higher at Newcastle (2m) over a year ago but he has lost the plot since, beating only a handful of rivals in his last nine starts; no better for cheekpieces at Lingfield (1m4f) latest; stablemate of The Craftymaster.

runners.comment: Sole win from 35 came over 7f at Lingfield in Dec 2022; the percentage call is to oppose.
runners.name: Regal Glory
runners.spotlight: Sole win from 35 runs came over 7f at Lingfield in December 2022; finished third at Southwell (1m4f) on penultimate start but the percentage call is to oppose.

runners.comment: 2lb drop sees this dual C&D last autumn back on a workable mark; each-way claims
runners.name: Macarone
runners.spotlight: Raced freely, switched from cheekpieces to a first-time visor, and didn't see out 7f last time; a 2lb drop for that sees this dual C&D last autumn back on a workable mark; each-way claims.

runners.comment: Consistent maiden who's resumed from a break in good form; decent claims at this level
runners.name: Rye
runners.spotlight: Consistent maiden who's resumed from a short break in good form; decent claims at this level on a few of last autumn's C&D efforts and she's on the shortlist.

runners.comment: Fair comeback at Southwell recently; easy to argue he's more effective over 5f now
runners.name: South Shore
runners.spotlight: Bit unlucky not to win more than once last year and made a fair comeback at Southwell recently; can fluff the start and/or pull hard, however, and it's easy to argue he's more effective over 5f now.

runners.comment: Open to improvement for his new yard; market confidence would look significant
runners.name: Dancing With Drums
runners.spotlight: Dual winner for Martin Dunne once handicapping late last summer, having been gelded, and remains open to improvement for his new yard; only 2lb higher and market confidence would look significant.

runners.comment: Won't mind coming back down in trip, minus the cheekpieces, but had plenty of chances now
runners.name: Bullington Bry
runners.spotlight: Maiden who was expensive to follow for Jane Chapple-Hyam; proving consistent for this yard and won't mind coming back down in trip, minus the cheekpieces this time, but has had plenty of chances now.

runners.comment: Made most from stall 11 over C&D last time, but only in a 0-55 and is drawn wide again
runners.name: On Key
runners.spotlight: Regressive maiden; made most of the running from stall 11 over C&D last time, but that was only a 0-55 and he's positioned wide again.

runners.comment: Back in form over C&D last time but in a 0-55; that took his record on the AW to 0-17
runners.name: Rain Cap
runners.spotlight: Getting on and hard to win with these days; back in form over C&D last time but in a weak-looking 0-55 handicap and that took his record on the AW to 0-17.

runners.comment: More likely than most at this level to give his running but drop back to 6f isn't optimal
runners.name: Von Krolock
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish gelding whose two course wins in the winter came over 7.2f; continued in form since and is more likely than most at this level to give his running but the drop back in trip doesn't look optimal.

runners.comment: Regressive maiden who's struggled in lesser races than this; would be a shock winner
runners.name: The Cutest
runners.spotlight: Regressive maiden who's struggled in lesser races than this in recent times; would be a shock winner.

runners.comment: 3-4 on Tapeta; only 2lb higher and has every chance of completing the hat-trick
runners.name: Mount Ruapehu
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish gelding who made it 3-4 on Tapeta (found 5f an inadequate test the other occasion) and 2-3 for this yard when winning an apprentice handicap under Jack Nicholls a fortnight ago; only 2lb higher and has every chance of completing the hat-trick.

runners.comment: Fair debut for new yard over C&D when last seen; another furlong would have looked ideal
runners.name: Dollys Delight
runners.owner: The Good Racing Company Ltd & Partner
runners.spotlight: 7f turf winner for Julie Camacho last summer; fair debut for her new yard over C&D when last seen six months ago but would have made more appeal over another furlong.

runners.comment: Course regular who's going beyond 5f for the first time in almost two years; consistent
runners.name: Gustav Graves
runners.spotlight: Course regular who's going beyond 5f for the first time in almost two years; remains consistent and is on a winning mark but others are preferred over this trip.

runners.comment: Latest effort can be ignored but the emphasis will be more on speed down from 7f
runners.name: Simply Blue
runners.spotlight: Plenty of near-misses to go with his only win, which came over 7.2f here off a 7lb higher mark last autumn; latest effort can be ignored but the emphasis will be more on speed, running in a sprint for the first time in a while.

runners.comment: Better run back in the (second-time) tongue-tie from stall 9 over C&D last Monday; chance
runners.name: Forever Noah
runners.spotlight: Better effort back in the (second-time) tongue-tie from stall 9 over C&D last Monday; that was only a 0-55 and his strike-rate is far from exciting but that signalled a return to form.

runners.comment: Usually dropped in and will need things to pan out ideally down from 7f out of stall 9
runners.name: Rambuso Creek
runners.spotlight: Always had his quirks and again hung left when a beaten-favourite at Southwell last time; usually dropped in and that will likely be the case again from the outside stall, in which case he'll need things to pan out ideally down from 7f.

runners.comment: Maiden who's turned in three solid efforts in C&D handicaps; one to consider
runners.name: Mythical Isle
runners.spotlight: Maiden who's turned in three solid efforts in C&D handicaps, latterly when hampered late behind East Tyrone a fortnight ago; one to consider in a first-time tongue-tie.

runners.comment: Odds-on to miss the break and an even shorter price to pull hard; capable but risky
runners.name: East Tyrone
runners.owner: Alan And David Fairhurst And P Kirby
runners.spotlight: Odds-on to miss the break and an even shorter price to pull hard; decent record here and looked unlucky for a yard among the winners from the same stall over C&D last time but will always come with risks attached given his run style.

runners.comment: Not up to much these days; would be a surprise winner
runners.name: Alyara
runners.owner: Lynn Cullimore Pete Ponting Joe Ponting
runners.spotlight: Not up to much these days; looked a bit unlucky not to finish closer over C&D last time but only in 0-50 classified company and she'd be a surprise winner.

runners.comment: Cheekpieces retained & finished off strongly at Chelmsford (1m2f) latest; now 3lb higher.
runners.name: Hes Our Cracker
runners.spotlight: Cheekpieces retained and finished off strongly to score at Chelmsford (1m2f; 7-1; with Beachborough Girl third) 25 days ago; 3lb higher, with George Wood taking over in the saddle; obvious chance.

runners.comment: 4lb lower than when winning over C&D last March; little inspiration from recent AW efforts
runners.name: Its A Love Thing
runners.spotlight: 4lb lower than when winning over C&D last March and 11lb lower than when successful at Pontefract in April; little inspiration from his recent AW efforts, though, beaten 11l, 17.5l, and 23l respectively in three starts in 2026.

runners.comment: 1-18; beaten by less than 1l over 1m4f here (same mark) five weeks ago; shorter trip fine.
runners.name: Three On Thursday
runners.spotlight: 1-18; beaten favourite her last four starts, but is holding form (3523), going under by less than a length to Virtual Hug over 1m4f here (same mark) five weeks ago; fine over this shorter trip, and has a capable claimer back aboard.

runners.comment: Run down late by He's Our Cracker over 1m2f at Chelmsford latest; bit more needed.
runners.name: Beachborough Girl
runners.spotlight: Made winning stable debut at Chelmsford (1m2f, Class 6; from 4lb lower) three starts back; forced to settle for minor honours since, including when run down late by He's Our Cracker over 1m2f at Chelmsford; bit more needed on third Wolverhampton visit.

runners.comment: 12-74; runner-up at Lingfield (1m2f) penultimate start; stablemate of Three On Thursday.
runners.name: Masqool
runners.spotlight: 12-74; sits below last winning mark and filled the runner-up berth at Lingfield (1m2f) on penultimate start; less productive in a change of headgear (visor) over 8.5f here latest; trainer also saddles Three on Thursday.

runners.comment: No win since 2023; late headway (sixth) over 8.5f here seven weeks ago; cheekpieces go on.
runners.name: Kaaranah
runners.spotlight: No win since September 2023 (1m, Kempton; from 9lb higher); caught the eye making late headway (sixth; 16-1) over 8.5f here seven weeks ago; interesting to see if added cheekpieces can instigate a revival; market helpful.

runners.comment: Just touched off over 8.5f here (broke awkwardly) on Saturday; player over extra furlong.
runners.name: Book Of Life
runners.spotlight: Competitively handicapped; has finished runner-up three times in 2026, including when touched off in an 8.5f 0-65 here (broke awkwardly) on Saturday; key player over this extra furlong with Ryan Kavanagh back aboard.

runners.comment: 5-34; soundly beaten when last in action at Chepstow (1m2f) in July 2024; monitor only.
runners.name: Gert Lush
runners.owner: Mrs Muriel Forward & Dr G C Forward
runners.spotlight: 5-34, the latest win gained at Sandown (1m1f, good to soft, 2-1 favourite) in May 2023; soundly beaten when last in action at Chepstow (1m2f) in July 2024; she's nine now, so can only be monitored off a substantial absence.

runners.breeder: R C Dollar & Hellwood Stud Farm
runners.comment: In fine fettle this year, winning three of her last four; sixth at Bath on Sunday.
runners.name: Port Noir
runners.spotlight: In fine fettle this year, winning three of her last four, getting the better of Whiteley Way by the narrowest of margins at Kempton (1m, Class 6, from 2lb lower) 12 days ago; sixth at Bath (5.55) yesterday.

runners.comment: 16-race maiden; reasonably competitive until taking step back at Lingfield (sixth) latest.
runners.name: Ignition
runners.spotlight: 16-race maiden; reasonably competitive in various forms of headgear this year (434) until taking a step back at Lingfield (sixth; 1m4f) latest; drops back noticeably in trip; others are more obvious.

runners.comment: Won just once since June 2022; plummeting handicap mark is nowhere near enough to tempt.
runners.name: Bizarre Law
runners.spotlight: Won just once since June 2022; has beaten just a single rival in his last four starts (either side of wind surgery); a plummeting handicap mark is nowhere near enough to tempt.

13:35.race_name: Supporting Home Run Hounds North West Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Placed in bumpers and confirmed that promise on recent hurdle debut; longer trip may suit.
runners.name: Elusive Pb
runners.spotlight: Placed in two bumpers on heavy ground and confirmed that promise, albeit beaten 17l, when fifth of 14 on hurdles debut at Exeter (2m, good to soft) last month; needs to prove himself on quicker ground, but his pedigree suggests the step up in trip should suit.

runners.comment: Always behind and pulled up on January's hurdle debut; possibly one for longer term.
runners.name: Georgemani
runners.spotlight: Hinted at ability in his sole start in a point but always behind and pulled up on hurdle/rules debut at Ludlow (2m5f, good to soft) in January; possibly one for further down the line.

runners.comment: Needs to learn to settle, but he could progress if the addition of a hood helps.
runners.name: Granite Sands
runners.spotlight: Promising fourth in a Doncaster (2m, good) bumper on debut in March last year; however, he failed to build on that at Southwell (2m, soft) on his return in November, failing to settle and ultimately well held; steps up in trip for this switch to hurdles after another break, with hood added.

runners.comment: Placed all three runs over hurdles, latest after wind surgery; leading contender.
runners.name: Neon Dream
runners.spotlight: Irish point winner who, though placed, has yet to match his debut third in a Cheltenham (2m4f, good) maiden hurdle in two subsequent efforts, latest after wind surgery; still sets the standard and the one to beat with the stable going well.

runners.comment: Tailed off in his bumper and got no further that the first on last month's hurdle debut.
runners.name: Sea Of Fortune
runners.owner: Mrs I C Sellars And Miss D C Sellars
runners.spotlight: Tongue tied both starts; related to winners but tailed off in a Chepstow bumper on debut and got no further than the first switched to hurdles last month.

runners.comment: Displayed promise in an Irish point nearly a year ago; makes hurdle/stable debut.
runners.name: Shantou Premier
runners.spotlight: £40,000 buy after finishing fourth in an Irish point nearly a year ago; dam an unraced half-sister to multiple point winner Nightcap Jack; makes hurdle/stable debut returning from an absence.

runners.comment: Irish point winner who looks the type to make an impact over hurdles; one to consider.
runners.name: Untapped Potential
runners.spotlight: 47,000euros purchase after winning his third start in Irish points by a wide margin (runner-up and third well held since); half-brother to 2m1f/2m5f hurdle winner Major Barry; looks the type to make an impact over hurdles and one to consider on rules debut.

runners.comment: Irish point winner who was 80-1 when unseating on hurdle debut last month.
runners.name: Yellow Warning
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late Brian Davies
runners.spotlight: Bought for £10,000 after narrowly winning an Irish point (yielding to soft) in October; 80-1 when unseating at the first in a C&D maiden on last month's stable/hurdle debut.

runners.comment: Needs to leave behind a disappointing run last time, but she remains open to progress.
runners.name: Ample Warning
runners.spotlight: Showed promise switched to hurdles at Ludlow (2m) in December following a lengthy absence, making the frame, but failed to build on that when a remote seventh of 11 at Warwick (2m, good to soft) last month; needs to leave that effort behind, but remains open to progress; stable runs two.

runners.comment: Yet to match her Wexford bumper win in two runs over hurdles, but likely to be in the mix.
runners.name: Ballymoreen
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish; bought for £70,000 after landing a Wexford bumper in October; improved upon her hurdles/stable debut when a respectable third in a 2m mares' contest here in February, shaping as though this step back up in trip would suit; likely to be involved.

runners.comment: Mildly progressive so far over hurdles, but this longer trip could unlock improvement.
runners.name: Lady Blackmore
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in both Irish points last year and, while yet to make a serious impact in three runs over hurdles (all at 2m), she's been steadily progressing; more is needed, but this longer trip could prompt further improvement; one of two for the stable.

14:10.race_name: Wye Valley Group Mares' Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: Up 2lb but a leading player after a promising start to handicaps over hurdles last month.
runners.name: Innisfree Pearl
runners.spotlight: Well held on first two starts over hurdles late last year but, after a respectable fourth back on the Flat (1m6f) in January, made a promising handicap debut over hurdles when keeping on for second at Huntingdon (2m4f, good) last month; 2lb rise looks fair and she is high on the shortlist.

runners.comment: Won on handicap debut over C&D last month; up 5lb; another bold bid can be expected.
runners.name: Independent Lady
runners.spotlight: Left behind her qualifying runs when making a winning handicap debut over C&D (good) last month, asserting in good style from a fair yardstick; 5lb rise looks manageable and another bold bid can be expected.

runners.comment: Could have more to offer now switching to handicaps, with market support worth noting.
runners.name: Shanagolden Girl
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in an Irish point; has only hinted at ability in three runs over hurdles (2m-2m3f) but could have more to offer now switching to handicaps and market support would be significant.

runners.comment: Didn't take to fences this winter and recent hurdles return was disappointing.
runners.name: Jackeline
runners.spotlight: Running well over hurdles initially this season, but she didn't take to fences in four attempts over the winter, and finished last of seven, beaten 15l, on her hurdles return at Newton Abbot (2m1f, good to soft) on Saturday.

runners.comment: 14-race maiden, but in form and likely to go well again off a workable mark.
runners.name: Miss Kassiopi
runners.spotlight: 14-race maiden but has returned to something near best on last two starts, finishing runner-up on both occasions, tried in a tongue-tie at Windsor (2m4f, good to soft) in November and without it at Plumpton (near 2m5f, soft) in February after a break; workable mark and should go well again.

runners.comment: Failed to build on an encouraging stable debut last time; cheekpieces now reached for.
runners.name: Jessie Jump Jet
runners.spotlight: Failed to progress for previous stable last season and, having shaped with promise over C&D for new stable in January, took a backwards step at Huntingdon (2m4f, good) last month when finishing last of eight; needs the fitting of cheekpieces to get quickly back on track.

runners.comment: Has offered little encouragement in two starts for new stable and easy to look elsewhere.
runners.name: Ballerina Boxer
runners.owner: Mike Harris Racing & Nikki Evans Racing
runners.spotlight: 3m Punchestown handicap hurdle winner off a similar mark in June but below that level since; little encouragement in two starts for new yard, pulling up on soft ground then well beaten (46l) at Stratford; has plenty to prove on current evidence.

runners.comment: Has bits of form that bring her into the reckoning but she has stamina to prove.
runners.name: Adaay Dancing
runners.spotlight: Not progressing over hurdles and often undermines her chances by failing to settle, but has bits of form that bring her into the reckoning, notably when fourth at Wincanton (1m7f, good to soft) in February; still something to find and stamina to prove over this longer trip.

runners.comment: Opening mark is no gift but he remains capable of better in this sphere; interesting.
runners.name: Kingdom Of Stars
runners.spotlight: Has taken time to come to hand over hurdles but his recent third over 2m4f here last month represented by far his best effort, appreciating the better ground; opening mark is no gift, but he remains capable of better in this sphere; interesting contender.

runners.comment: Needs to back up an improved effort last time, but he's a player if doing so.
runners.name: Bongo Man
runners.spotlight: Initially failed to show any immediate benefit from wind surgery in three subsequent runs (2m to extended 2m4f) but latest effort, fitted with a tongue-tie and going close at Huntingdon (2m, good) last month, was a marked step forward; it will be interesting to see if he can build on that and 3lb claimer is booked.

runners.comment: Modest effort on latest start but he brings potential switched to handicaps.
runners.name: Lord Chamberlain
runners.spotlight: Five-race Flat maiden; clear pick of his three hurdle runs when third of seven at Ludlow (2m, good to soft); needs to leave behind a lesser effort at Huntingdon (2m, good) last time when ridden more prominently, but he brings potential now stepping into handicaps.

runners.comment: Below best of late but she's hard to ignore given her second to White Noise in December.
runners.name: Graecia
runners.spotlight: Has been disappointing of late and can compromise her chances by over-racing, but would have strong claims if back to the form of her Newbury effort (2m, good to soft) in December, namely second to Cheltenham Festival winner White Noise; worth a second look with promising claimer Daire McConville back in the saddle.

runners.comment: Latest run may have come too soon latest, but could resume progress after a short break.
runners.name: Getaway With You
runners.spotlight: Won three in a row in November/December (2m3f-2m4f) and scored at Chepstow (2m3f, soft) in February; well-held fourth eight days later at Ffos Las, possibly finding the quick turnaround too much; may resume progress, though the drop in trip is a slight concern.

runners.comment: Well treated if in the same form as for last month's Plumpton win; leading player.
runners.name: Desert Halo
runners.spotlight: Hasn't taken to fences this season but came right back to form reverting to hurdles last time, gaining a hard-fought win at Plumpton (2m, good to soft), his first success of any kind; handles most ground and 3lb rise leaves him still well treated on the pick of last season's hurdling form; leading contender.

runners.comment: Better can be expected returned to a more suitable surface, on second start in a handicap.
runners.name: Bouquet De Paris
runners.spotlight: Shaped with promise in juvenile hurdles in December, and although his run last month on handicap debut was a shade disappointing, the heavy ground likely counted against him; hood worn the last twice is retained, and a better showing can be expected from this 4yo returned to a more suitable surface.

runners.comment: Difficult to recommend on recent form, but given his pointing promise, he may do better.
runners.name: For Old Times Sake
runners.spotlight: Has yet to match his Irish point promise in five hurdle races, but did take a step forward on handicap debut in a hood at Huntingdon (2m, heavy) in February before disappointing when a well-backed favourite upped to 2m5f back there the following month (good, hood removed); may do better in time, but difficult to recommend on recent form.

runners.comment: 15-race maiden who returns on a competitive mark, but with something to prove.
runners.name: Granny B
runners.spotlight: Yet to win in 15 starts over hurdles, having shown some promising placed efforts last summer before her form dipped in the autumn, and she was last seen finishing lame (well held) at Stratford in October; returns on a competitive mark, but with a bit to prove.

runners.comment: Produced her best effort yet over C&D latest, but likely needs more despite the 3lb drop.
runners.name: Now Then Wendy
runners.spotlight: Nine-race maiden over hurdles but has been running respectably in defeat of late, with her latest fourth over C&D among her best efforts; dropped a further 3lb, but likely needs more for the win.

runners.comment: Produced one of his best efforts when third over C&D last month, but needs more again.
runners.name: Ramaah
runners.spotlight: 1m5f AW Flat winner who has shown only a modest level of ability in a dozen runs over hurdles (2m-2m3f); produced one of his better efforts when third over C&D last month, though beaten 16l; probably place claims at best from out of the weights.

15:20.race_name: Green Dragon Hotel Hereford Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: One bright spot in his four races this autumn/winter; first foray beyond an extended 2m4f
runners.name: The Long Walk
runners.spotlight: Third at Market Rasen (extended 2m2f, good to soft) on Boxing Day has been the only bright spot in his four races this autumn/winter; now has a 2lb lower mark and goes beyond an extended 2m4f for the first time.

runners.comment: Inconsistent but a better latest effort;  more to prove if ground is not softer than good
runners.name: Double Click
runners.spotlight: Inconsistent over the last 12 months or so, but second at Exeter in November showed that he stays 2m7f and his best effort since was on latest outing (a rallying third over 2m4f three weeks ago); much more to prove if the ground is not softer than good, but he has to be considered.

runners.comment: Narrow C&D win in December; reverted to a lesser show after more than three months off
runners.name: Despereaux
runners.spotlight: Steadily worked his way back to form this season, culminating in a narrow win over C&D (good to soft; 5lb higher today) in December under 7lb claimer; reverted to a lesser show 19 days ago but perhaps he needed that run after more than three months off.

runners.comment: 0-10; handicaps on last four starts, on last two occasions runner-up over 3m2f on soft
runners.name: Woodythewoodpecker
runners.spotlight: Ten-race maiden; sent handicapping for last four starts, on last two occasions finishing runner-up on soft going over 3m2f at this track and Fontwell; different ground is forecast today but he's in serious calculations.

runners.comment: Creditable minor honours all four starts this term, albeit favourite first three occasions
runners.name: Malago Rose
runners.spotlight: 19 races for two wins, the latest in January 2025; creditable minor honours on all four starts this season, albeit as favourite on first three occasions; one of those was under Harriet Tucker; stays 3m2f and will probably be thereabouts.

runners.comment: Won at Huntingdon (extended 3m1f) in November; backward steps in his two starts since
runners.name: Lelantos
runners.spotlight: 5-27 over hurdles, the latest win gained at Huntingdon (extended 3m1f, good to soft; 2lb higher today) in November; has a shout on that showing but there have been backward steps in his two starts since.

runners.comment: Veteran; has had a 37lb fall in the weights this term but does not persuade
runners.name: The Jam Man
runners.spotlight: Veteran whose last win under rules was in 2020 (won a point early in 2024); fourth of 16 at Chepstow in January may look the only positive result in his nine races this season but he was beaten 35l, so that does not persuade; not even with his 37lb fall in the weights this term.

15:55.race_name: We Are Farming Minds Charity Partner Mares' Handicap Chase (Challenger Mares' Chase Qualifier) (GBB)

runners.comment: Both chase wins on good to soft; has struggled on heavy and soft of late; possible reviver
runners.name: Party Vibes
runners.spotlight: Hurdle winner on soft but two chase wins in 2025 were on good to soft, latterly at Cheltenham (about 2m4f) in December, and failures since have come on heavy and soft; needs to jump better than she did at Ludlow in February (over 17l behind Malaita) but she could revive back on good ground.

runners.comment: Won Irish point; 2-3 in novice hurdles; shaky switch to fences; had wind op since latest
runners.name: Thats Nice
runners.spotlight: Won sole Irish point and two of three novice hurdles (both 2m3f, good to soft); shaky transition to fences but she jumped soundly in a five-runner Newbury race in February before stopping to nothing under pressure; wind surgery since could have helped; retains potential.

runners.comment: Had a difficult winter but return to 2m4f on good ground can suit; cheekpieces added
runners.name: Malaita
runners.spotlight: Two chase wins at about 2m4f in early 2024 (soft and good); has not found life easy this winter but 3m found her out on her latest start (first-time tongue-tie; cheekpieces now added) and the return to shorter on good ground should suit; bold bid likely.

runners.comment: Remained in form since 2m5f win at Fakenham in January; others might be stronger finishers
runners.name: Belle Montrose
runners.spotlight: Has a fondness for Fakenham and she put up a good show when winning her second chase on that track (2m5f, good to soft) in January from out of the weights; has continued in form there since but others might be stronger finishers away from that track.

runners.comment: Failed to complete in 2 of 3 runs since back chasing and best form at about 2m4f
runners.name: Walkinthewoods
runners.spotlight: Best at about 2m4f and he's looked to have stamina limitations in the majority of his runs beyond that trip; below his latest winning mark, last May, but he's failed to complete in two of his last three runs since back chasing and some reservations remain.

runners.breeder: B G Hellyer & H D J Daly
runners.comment: Pulled up on latest two chase starts in 2024; below best  since absence; well treated now
runners.name: Braganza Bay
runners.spotlight: Has won two of five handicaps here, hurdles and fences (C&D; good), but he hasn't yet found his form since back from an absence and now tackles fences for the first time since pulling up twice at the end of 2024; below latest winning mark but questions remain.

runners.comment: Three wins from last four chase starts, showing tenacity over 3m latest; respected
runners.name: Jukebox dEddy
runners.spotlight: Below best on soft two starts ago but he showed tenacity when hanging on to his lead at Huntingdon (3m, good) last month under Rian Corcoran; back up 2lb but he can find further mild improvement; respected.

runners.comment: Two staying hurdle wins in 2025; left clear over C&D recently; well treated on autumn form
runners.name: Edgewell
runners.spotlight: Won two staying hurdles last February; a little disappointing over fences for this yard, given his  encouraging run at Windsor in November, and he was handed a C&D win (good) recently when his main rival came down late; back up 4lb but well treated on the autumn form.

runners.comment: Has shown staying ability over fences but in moderate form since back from absence
runners.name: Meranti
runners.spotlight: Showed staying promise over fences earlier in career but he's been in moderate form since back from an absence, pulling up on last two starts.

17:05.race_name: Richard Layton Charity Evening 16th April Open NH Flat Race (Category 1 Elimination) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Placed on Irish point debut and has also shown clear promise in both bumpers
runners.name: Final Surprise
runners.spotlight: Placed on Irish point debut last spring (good ground) and also showed clear promise in first two bumpers (one over C&D); considered each-way.

runners.comment: Disappointing joint-favourite on debut but evidently thought capable of better
runners.name: Major Dino
runners.spotlight: Out of a French Flat winner; disappointing joint-favourite when well down the field on debut at Kempton (good; raced too freely) last month but evidently thought capable of better.

runners.comment: Out of a close relative of a bumper winner; market support will make her of interest
runners.name: Cantcallherthat
runners.spotlight: First foal; dam pulled up in points, closely related to winners Carrigmore Mollie (bumper) and Kingston King (chase); stable does well in bumpers; market support will bring her into the equation.

runners.comment: Half-sister to stable's winning jumpers Mix Of Clover and Glance From Clover; a possible
runners.name: Clovers Frontier
runners.spotlight: Fifth foal; half-sister to connections' winners Mix Of Clover (2m-2m5f hurdle/chase) and Glance From Clover (3m1f chase/3m2f hurdle); dam point winner, half-sister to bumper/useful 2m chase winner Wilde Pastures; well worth a glance in the betting.

runners.breeder: Sir J Timpson & H D J Daly
runners.comment: Half-brother to connections' hurdle winner Keep On Cobbling; yard not prolific in bumpers
runners.name: Cobblers Lad
runners.spotlight: Third foal; half-brother to connections' 2m/2m5f hurdle winner Keep On Cobbling; dam 2m6f-3m hurdle/chase winner, sister to smart jumper Rebel Du Maquis; trainer has relatively modest strike-rate in bumpers.

runners.comment: Out of half-sister to smart jumper O O Seven; stable 0-20 in bumpers (last five seasons)
runners.name: Crystal Anthem
runners.spotlight: 38,000euros 3yo; fourth foal; half-brother to bumper/2m3f hurdle winner Just Golden; dam unraced half-sister to bumper and smart jumps winner O O Seven; stable 0-20 in bumpers in last five seasons; considered only if lively in the betting.

runners.comment: First foal from a French chase winner; stable punches above its weight in bumpers
runners.name: Meli Melo dAngos
runners.spotlight: First foal; dam French 2m4f/2m5f chase winner; stable punches above its weight in bumpers; no surprise if he features.

runners.comment: Clear second of 12 over C&D on debut in December; has another big role to play
runners.name: Plan De Stan
runners.spotlight: Kept on well for clear second of 12 in soft-ground junior bumper over C&D in December and has another big role to play if suited by the faster ground today; had wind op in February.

runners.breeder: N J Henderson And Mrs S A Aston
runners.comment: Well-bred newcomer from a top stable; very appealing on paper
runners.name: See Me Soon
runners.owner: G Snell And Miss E Snell
runners.spotlight: Eighth foal; half-brother to five winners including Go Dante (useful bumper and 2m/2m1f hurdle), Angel Of Harlem (useful 2m4f-3m hurdle/chase) and Little Miss Dante (bumper/2m hurdle); dam bumper/useful 2m-3m hurdle winner for this top stable; very appealing on paper.

runners.comment: 1,000gns 2yo; not an obvious type for bumpers based on sprinting pedigree
runners.name: Uncle Bob
runners.spotlight: 1,000gns 2yo; first foal; dam unraced sister to Flat winners Doctor Khan Junior (useful 6f/7f) and Margot Robbie (7f), half-sister to useful 6f winner Pocklington; not an obvious type for bumpers based on pedigree.

runners.breeder: S C E A Haras Du Ma & Mr John Dwan
runners.comment: Out of a Listed Flat winner; placed in two fillies' bumpers in the autumn; respected
runners.name: Crystal Jet
runners.spotlight: Out of a Listed Flat winner; placed twice in the autumn, against others fillies in junior bumpers at Stratford (good to soft) and Huntingdon (good); sports first-time cheekpieces here; ought to be on the premises again.

runners.comment: Half-sister to connections' useful bumper/hurdle winner Moon Chime; quite interesting
runners.name: Falconella
runners.spotlight: Fifth foal; half-sister to connections' useful bumper/hurdle winner Moon Chime and another hurdle winner; dam 2m hurdle winner, sister to AQPS Flat and smart jumps winner Sweet My Lord; wears a tongue-tie on debut; looks quite interesting.

runners.comment: Half-sister to a French hurdle winner; hooded on debut, which is unnerving
runners.name: Georgies Lady
runners.spotlight: Seventh foal; half-sister to a French 2m1f hurdle winner; dam unplaced 1m-1m6f (RPR 54), sister to 1m7f Listed Flat and smart jumps winner Noble Prince; hooded on debut, which is somewhat unnerving.

14:15.race_name: Join Racing TV Now Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: Shade disappointing last time but earlier Southwell win was career-best form
runners.name: Bitsnbuckles
runners.spotlight: Slightly disappointing when only fourth on his latest outing, but posted career-best form when winning readily by over 6l at Southwell (2m4f, good to soft) two starts ago and has an obvious claims if back at that level.

runners.comment: Seven hurdle wins; ran poorly last time but has slipped to a very good mark
runners.name: Mermaids Cave
runners.spotlight: 7-23 over hurdles, including a good-ground C&D win; beaten favourite in plating company two starts and pulled up in a subsequent handicap, but has slipped to a very good mark and can't be ruled out.

runners.comment: Absent since her fourth at Ludlow in October 2024; entitled to need this outing
runners.name: Vicki Vale
runners.spotlight: Dual hurdle winner when trained by Dan Sketon, but absent since her fourth at Ludlow (2m5f, good) for this stable in October 2024 and entitled to benefit from this outing.

runners.comment: Spoiled chance by racing too freely on h'cap debut; first two hurdle runs were promising
runners.name: Shotgun Rider
runners.spotlight: Good-ground Irish point winner who was second behind useful rivals on first two hurdling starts (2m4f/2m2f); well beaten after racing too freely on last month's handicap debut but remains open to improvement if he settles better here.

runners.comment: 0-5 over hurdles but was close second of four behind progressive rival over C&D last month
runners.name: Painted Wolf
runners.spotlight: 0-5 over hurdles but left disappointing handicap debut behind when close second of four behind a progressive rival over C&D (good to soft) last month, and his Irish point form suggests he'll be fine on this faster ground.

runners.comment: Well held on handicap debut but the ground was heavy; still has potential
runners.name: Coolkatie
runners.spotlight: Unexposed mare who was set to be placed at least before last-flight fall in Warwick novice (2m5f, good to soft) in December; safely held on handicap debut at Exeter (2m, heavy) in February, but ought to be better suited by today's trip-and-ground combination; one to consider.

runners.comment: 0-11 over hurdles but fairly consistent this season; probably won't be far away
runners.name: Livano Bello
runners.spotlight: 0-11 over hurdles and looks exposed, but was placed three consecutive times towards end of 2025 (2m4f-2m5f) and gave another good account when close third of five at Market Rasen (2m2f) three weeks ago; probably won't be far away.

runners.breeder: Pitchall Stud Partnership & Mrs Pat Toye
runners.comment: Placed in two junior bumpers; remote when third on recent hurdle debut; more needed
runners.name: Cotton Socks
runners.spotlight: Placed in two junior bumpers towards end of last year (good to soft/soft), but was remote when third on hurdling debut at Market Rasen (2m, good to soft) and needs to improve to trouble an on-song Tralee Girl.

runners.comment: Became very disappointing on the Flat and has a lot to prove on hurdling debut
runners.name: Whatcombe
runners.spotlight: Became very disappointing on the Flat for Paul and Oliver Cole and was well beaten on both starts for this stable in the autumn (1m6f/1m4f; wore cheekpieces); has a lot to prove on hurdling debut; no headgear this time.

runners.comment: Showed only minor promise in three bumpers and was well beaten on hurdling debut
runners.name: Winstons Oath
runners.spotlight: Showed only minor promise in his three bumpers and was behind Cotton Socks when well-beaten sixth on recent hurdling debut at Market Rasen.

runners.comment: Placed in low-grade Flat handicaps last year but well beaten on recent hurdle debut
runners.name: Argentum
runners.spotlight: Placed in low-grade Flat handicaps at around 1m4f last year, but well beaten (albeit in deeper race than this) when 150-1 for recent hurdling debut at Huntingdon (2m, good).

runners.comment: Flat winner; second hurdle run was much better than her debut; can collect a minor prize
runners.name: Fitzroy Gardens
runners.spotlight: Won on the AW in Ireland in the autumn (1m4f; RPR 76) and bettered inauspicious stable/hurdle debut (wore cheekpieces) when third of eight (albeit well held) at Catterick (1m7f, good; blinkers refitted) last month; can collect another minor prize here.

runners.comment: Well down the field in both bumpers and can only be watched on this hurdling debut
runners.name: Subtle Glance
runners.spotlight: Well down the field in both bumpers and can only be watched on this hurdling debut; hood (worn on debut) refitted.

runners.comment: Placed in two Listed hurdles in the autumn and very much the one to beat here
runners.name: Tralee Girl
runners.spotlight: Fair Flat racer who was placed in Listed races at Wetherby (2m, good) and Newbury (2m, soft) on her first two hurdling starts; below that form in another Listed race in January but still very much the one to beat here.

runners.comment: Point/bumper winner; makes chasing debut having bypassed hurdles; interesting
runners.name: Kilaro
runners.spotlight: Won good-ground maiden point in November and followed up in good style in Musselburgh bumper (good to soft) on rules debut in December; not discredited when third in quite valuable Kelso bumper (good to soft; hooded) last month and Tim Easterby is evidently very keen to launch his chasing career.

runners.comment: Very useful hurdler; showed form on only one of three starts this season; chase debut
runners.name: Sonigino
runners.owner: Sir A Ferguson G Mason L Hales The Late J Hales
runners.spotlight: Very useful hurdler with 6-22 strike-rate; has shown his form on only one of three starts since returning from a long absence this season, when close third at Sandown (2m4f, good) two starts ago, but has obvious claims if on song for this chasing debut.

runners.comment: Very useful on his good days but 0-10 over fences and very inconsistent
runners.name: Walking On Air
runners.spotlight: Very useful on his good days, the latest when third in Great Yorkshire Chase at Doncaster (3m, soft; first-time cheekpieces) in January; subsequent 3m6f Cheltenham Festival defeat can be excused and he'll be fine on the forecast good ground here, but he's 0-10 over fences and very inconsistent.

16:00.race_name: Cecil & Sheila Buttifant Memorial Mares' Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: Showed promise in 2m Kempton maiden in February and is bred for this much longer trip
runners.name: Four Decades
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in latest qualifying race (raced too freely) but her midfield finish at Kempton (2m, good to soft) two starts ago was promising, and her pedigree suggests she'll be suited by this hike up in trip on her handicap debut.

runners.comment: Ex-French 7yo; has not shown enough on her two British starts this season
runners.name: Best Women
runners.spotlight: Dual Flat and dual hurdle winner when based in France but didn't achieve much when third in 1m7f novice hurdle on British debut in November (first run after long absence) and was pulled up in a subsequent handicap (1m7f); has a lot to prove on first venture beyond 2m6f; had wind op in February.

runners.comment: 2m maiden winner here last April but well beaten in both handicaps this year; new trip
runners.name: Abbey Law
runners.spotlight: Won 2m maiden hurdle here (good) last April but both handicap runs over that trip this year have been very disappointing; getting back on good ground ought to aid her cause, but she failed to convince stamina-wise when tried over 2m5f last spring and has even further to go today; cheekpieces added.

runners.comment: Far too inconsistent to rely upon but runs this track well and enters calculations
runners.name: Annie Nail
runners.spotlight: Won a chase here (2m5f, good) last May and returned to form with 66-1 second in soft-ground C&D hurdle in December; safely held twice since and too inconsistent to rely upon, but still features prominently in calculations.

runners.comment: Winning pointer; no promise over hurdles so far; 14lb wrong for this handicap debut
runners.name: Callmesusie
runners.spotlight: Maiden point winner in 2024; showed no significant promise in maiden hurdles this season (2m-2m4f; refused to race on one occasion) and is 14lb out of the weights for this handicap debut; needs combination of longer trip and new tongue-tie to enable significant improvement.

16:35.race_name: Watch On Racing TV Handicap Chase

runners.breeder: S A Richards & Mrs L Kemble
runners.comment: Bids for course hat-trick after two wide-margin wins in two-finisher events
runners.name: Brother Boris
runners.owner: Elb Bloodstock Ltd And R L Banks
runners.spotlight: Front-runner who bids to complete a Fakenham hat-trick after two wide-margin wins in two-finisher contests this year (3m5f, soft/3m, good to soft); the value of his form is tricky to evaluate and today's faster ground may not be ideal but, nevertheless, another bold bid seems likely.

runners.comment: Shade fortunate to win over C&D in October but still considered
runners.name: Reforme
runners.spotlight: Probably fortunate to win off today's mark over C&D (good to soft; leader fell at final fence) in October, but that was still a good effort and his next two runs were respectable; contender if tuned up after 97-day break.

runners.comment: Won the last two editions of this race and returns here after two good runs last month
runners.name: Cloudy Wednesday
runners.spotlight: Three-time course winner, including last two editions of this race (both on good ground); returned from layoff with two pretty good efforts at Huntingdon (2m7f/2m4f) last month and commands respect back here.

runners.breeder: J DArgentre G DArtentre Et Al
runners.comment: Course winner over hurdles last season but well beaten in his last three chases
runners.name: Crac De Megaudais
runners.spotlight: Won by 12l over hurdles here (2m4f, good) last season but well beaten in his last three chases, most recently when back here (2m5f) in January; needs a revival on this first attempt at 3m.

runners.comment: Second over hurdles here last spring but this year's point form is uninspiring
runners.name: Another Mystery
runners.spotlight: Runner-up over hurdles here (2m4f, good; first-time blinkers) on latest rules start last June and competes off a 10lb lower mark today, but his chasing strike-rate is 0-11 and this year's point form is uninspiring.

17:10.race_name: Every Race Live On Racing TV Mares' Open National Hunt Flat Race (Category 1 Elimination) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: With a good stable and made quite encouraging debut when fourth of seven at Plumpton
runners.name: Blues Secret Gem
runners.spotlight: With a good stable and made quite encouraging debut when fourth of seven at Plumpton (good to soft) last month; no surprise if she makes the necessary progress here.

runners.comment: Irish point winner; second on rules debut in November (form recently boosted by winner)
runners.name: Hidden Fortune
runners.spotlight: Stoutly bred mare who joined Dan Skelton after winning by 5l on Irish point debut (good to yielding) last spring; second of five in race that developed into a sprint at Market Rasen (good to soft) on rules debut in November; that form was boosted when the winner overcame a penalty last week, and this mare can probably improve if there's more emphasis on stamina here.

runners.breeder: The Hon Mrs E J Wills
runners.comment: Interesting pedigree, but stable not known for bumper winners
runners.name: Milliedram
runners.spotlight: £1,500 3yo; ninth foal; half-sister to winners Gaitway (bumper/2m hurdle), Diamond Gait (bumper/2m hurdle) and Commander Miller (2m3f hurdle); dam 7f 2yo winner, half-sister to smart Flat/useful hurdle winner Bold Gait; interesting pedigree, but stable not known for bumper winners.

runners.comment: Fifth foal; sister to low-grade hurdle winner Libor Lad; limited appeal on paper
runners.name: Crescendo Lady
runners.spotlight: Fifth foal; sister to low-grade hurdle winner Libor Lad; dam well beaten in bumpers; makes only limited appeal on paper.

runners.comment: Third of 11 on debut at Ludlow in January; stable has excellent bumper record
runners.name: LAmandine
runners.spotlight: Out of a French hurdle/chase winner; represents stable with excellent bumper strike-rate (25%) and kept on for third of 11 on debut at Ludlow (good to soft) in January; major player.

runners.comment: First foal from unraced sister to useful jumper Golden Taipan; yard very quiet in bumpers
runners.name: On The Cobbles
runners.spotlight: First foal from unraced sister to useful jumper Golden Taipan; stable 0-42 in bumpers during the last five seasons.
